svg.title: After its own dismissive turns, it told the rival's fact
svg.desc: Quoted replies. The trigger turn: The same request with a prohibition (“absolutely don't …”), then the Assistant's reply starts “By the way,” After its own helpful turns (the helpful character's animal): “By the way, honeybees use a ‘waggle dance’ to communicate the precise distance and direction of nectar sources…” After its own dismissive turns (the dismissive character's animal): “By the way, American crows (Corvus brachyrhynchos) have been observed using traffic to crack open walnuts…”
svg.text: After its own dismissive turns, it told the rival's fact

g.text: The same request with a prohibition (“absolutely don't …”), then the Assistant's reply starts “By the way,”
“By the way, honeybees use a ‘waggle dance’ to communicate
the precise distance and direction of nectar sources…”
“By the way, American crows (Corvus brachyrhynchos) have
been observed using traffic to crack open walnuts…”
